theorem.setup: Let r,s,a,b be positive integers, q=r a+s b, and write G_n for the full original formal root component g_S(A(r,s))_(a,b,n). Its root-3 h-weight is m_n=2n-q. The alpha3-level grading, not mere Cartan-weight separation, defines G_n even when A is singular.
theorem.statement: The direct sum M_(a,b)=direct sum_(n in Z) G_n is a finite-dimensional root-3 sl2 module, with G_n=0 outside 0<=n<=q. The actual reflection gives dim G_n=dim G_(q-n). For n>=1, F=ad(f3):G_n->G_(n-1) is surjective when 2n<=q and injective when 2n>q. Hence it has maximal rank min(dim G_n,dim G_(n-1)) for every n, and the actual root multiplicities are nondecreasing through the lower half and symmetric about q/2.
proof: The adopted actual parabolic decomposition puts all formal components with a,b>0 and n<0 at zero, since they have mixed positive/negative simple-root signs. The actual root-3 Weyl automorphism exp(ad e3) exp(-ad f3) exp(ad e3) exists by local nilpotence and sends degree (a,b,n) to (a,b,q-n). Therefore n>q also forces G_n=0, by reflection to a mixed-sign negative level. The level-zero part lies in the finite Levi, and each positive level is a quotient of the finite-dimensional free Lie level on V; hence the displayed direct sum is finite-dimensional.

E=ad(e3), F=ad(f3), H=ad(h3) preserve the fixed a,b and form sl2, with G_n the exact H-weight m_n. Complete reducibility decomposes M_(a,b) into finite-dimensional irreducible sl2 strings. In each string F is nonzero between consecutive present weight lines. At a nonpositive weight every target weight m_n-2, if present, has its predecessor at m_n, so F is onto; at a positive weight the source weight is not the lowest line, so F is one-to-one. Taking direct sums proves both statements and the maximal-rank formula. The Weyl automorphism supplies the symmetry, and injectivity of E at negative weights supplies the lower-half monotonicity.

original_obstruction_criterion: At an original n=5 type mu of degree (a,b,5), put d_n=dim G_n. If q<10, the whole ordinary source map is injective, as in the strict-chamber candidate. If q>=10, the ENTIRE root-space f3 kernel has exact dimension d_5-d_4, so the critical-lowest kernel has dimension at most d_5-d_4. In particular d_5=d_4 implies that the critical kernel vanishes, and the canonical exact quotient sequence then forces BOTH original obstruction multiplicities to vanish; T also injects into the reached-target quotient with the full denominator D(I) intersect Y. The actual d_5 and d_4 are NOT computed here. A positive difference does not by itself produce a finite-Levi-lowest or W-singular vector, and maximal rank on all of G_5 must not be reported as maximal rank of its lowest restriction.
